text:
Ari: Hey team — I pushed a PRD draft for the API variant routing work (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank). Need spec review for acceptance criteria, rollout gates, and edge cases. doc: https://redwood.internal/specs/variant-routing-prd
Priya: taking a look now. Quick ask: include explicit acceptance criteria for rerank tie-breaking (deterministic), and cost guardrails (target cost delta vs baseline).
Connor: can we clarify the rollout canary plan? my suggestion: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on quality regression (>2% degrade on precision@k) or latency SLO miss.
Jules: embedding compatibility note: embed-v2 dims = 1536; if we return variants with different dims we need client hints or a compatibility shim. also watch for index re-ingest migration cost.
Ellen: ops concern: the default batching config in PRD will blow up p99 on small requests if we allow 200ms accumulate window. propose lowering batch wait to 20ms for low-latency routes and add optional high-throughput tier.
Ari: good call. I'll add two route profiles: "low-latency" (batch_wait=20ms, max_batch=8) and "throughput" (batch_wait=80ms, max_batch=256). Also adding SLA target: 99.9% for p95 latency per route.
Priya: acceptance criteria draft (quick):
- deterministic rerank: identical input + seed -> stable ordering 99.99%
- fallback: if primary model exceeds 150ms p95, route to cheaper variant preserving schema
- cost: average cost per 1k tokens <= 110% of baseline for host customers
- embedding compat: clients get metadata {"dim":1536} in response for auto-handling
Can we make these explicit in PRD?
Connor: for rollout gating add metrics and thresholds: quality (precision@5), latency (p95), error rate (5xx). Automate gating in console: fail on two consecutive windows of 5m where threshold broken.
Jules: edgecase: rerank with zero-scoring ties — define deterministic tie-breaker: timestamp of ingestion -> fallback to id hash. Also call out behavior for partial results when KV cache warmup still happening.
Ellen: add runbook snippet please. ops needs clear steps: how to force route -> fallback, revoke canary, and emergency hotfix model pin.
Ari: adding sample config snippet to PRD for routing rules:
```
route: /v1/chat/completions
  variants:
    - name: model-a-lowlat
      profile: low-latency
      weight: 90
    - name: model-a-compact
      profile: throughput
      weight: 10
fallback_policy: prefer-compact-on-latency
rollback: on-quality-degrade: 2%
```
Priya: small nit — spell out datatypes for metadata (string keys) and show example response payload for embeddings and rerank. helps SDK teams.
Connor: also note canary traffic should be split by user-ids first, then %; otherwise internal bots skew metrics. prefer deterministic hashing for user-id assignment.
release-bot: [deploy-check] PRD updated by Ari — lint OK, link-check OK
Ari: thanks. I'll iterate and post an updated PRD by EOD. Please reply with LGTM or blockers. If nobody objects I'll mark for cross-team review tomorrow.
Priya: LGTM assuming the compatibility shim is documented.
Connor: LGTM.
Jules: LGTM with the tie-breaker clause added.
Ellen: LGTM after runbook paragraph is added.
Ari: great — noted action items: add runbook, compatibility shim example, explicit response schemas, and finalized rollout gating windows. Will ping again when updated.
